summary: The default ports and inventory variables are configurable; 443 is used for HTTPS and port 80 only when HTTPS is disabled with `nginx_disable_https`, `automationhub_disable_https`, `automationedacontroller_disable_https` (RPM) or `controller_nginx_disable_https`, `hub_nginx_disable_https`, `eda_nginx_disable_https` (containerized).
questions: Which variables disable HTTPS in the containerized installer?
